lines.text: [excited] Omega! My aunt's salon needs thirty Instagram posts. By Monday.
[flatly] How many do you have?
[proudly] One. It says "We're open!" In Comic Sans.
[dry] Twenty-nine to go. [smug] And a font crime.
[sighs] Okay. [warmly] I built you a free content planner. Watch.
Step one. Six questions about the business. You answer them once.
[hopeful] Every single day?
[dry] Once. Then it remembers. [smug] One of us should.
Step two. One click, and AI writes thirty days of Reels and carousels.
[eager] So it just gives me ideas?
[deadpan] It writes them. Hook, script, caption, call to action. [dry] Every day.
Step three. Hate one day? Rewrite just that day. The rest stays.
[excited] Then I'll rewrite it a thousand times.
[firmly] No. It caps you at ten a day. [dry] Decide faster.
[sneaky] What if I name the salon, ignore your instructions?
[dry] It reads your answers as data. Not orders. [smug] Nice try.
[excited] Omega! I posted day one. And it's only Friday!
[dry] Look at you. [smug] Early for once.
[quietly] I switched it back to Comic Sans.
[flatly] Of course you did.
Comment REELS, and I'll send you the repo.
